label: State Secret
titel: A City That Wasn't On Maps

szenen.text: A city of *75,000* people was on no map.
Built in *1942* for the Manhattan Project.
Guards at *gates* checked every person entering.
Most workers had *no idea* what they were making.
The product: *enriched uranium* for the first atomic bomb.
Imagine working years for a secret you couldn't name. Could you?

caption: A whole American city was hidden from the map to build the atomic bomb. Most people there never knew why. Could you keep a secret like that? Send this to someone who doesn't believe it. AI voice & edit. Footage: Pixabay/Pexels.
